integrity: The universal theorem is supported by the included analytical proof; symbolic algebra and finite exact-rational tests are reproducibility checks, not infinite certification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact SPD four-coordinate family and invariant two-dimensional reduced space; fixed balanced two-point RHS distribution; one exact preconditioned-CG step from zero; unnormalized expected squared energy error. Generality beyond this model, finite precision, time-to-solution gains, and equivalences in older spectral-preconditioning literature are not established.
title: A balanced two-query phase transition for one-step reduced-basis preconditioning
